svg.text: Round 10 · Shot-by-Shot Video Forensics & Hybrid Remake Router Selection FAQ
JuneYaooo/rea-video (v0.1.0, Apache-2.0, Track B #5: ~409★/day lifecycle avg, stars_today: not_measured) vs. Blind All-Diffusion Remake
CLAIM-R10-01/02 · VERIFIED
1. rea-video (v0.1.0) 4-Stage Deterministic-First Pipeline
Stage 1–2: Local Shot Cut + UVR MDX-Net Stems + Pixel Forensics ($0 API)
• Cuts shots + splits vocals.wav / music.wav via onnxruntime UVR MDX-Net (~67 MB)
• Measures AIGC tags, 24fps pull-up (dup_ratio<0.02), dark grain (std>=0.3) & OCR
Stage 3: Jump-Cut Grouping vlm_units() + Calibrated Fusion (VLM_WEIGHT=0.7)
• Merges jump-cut pieces of 1 camera setup (TAKE_MAX_S=12.0s, TAKE_MAX_PIECES=8)
• DET_WEIGHT (static_hold 1.6, still_motion 1.4, code_render 1.0) guards hard physics
Stage 4: Capability-Aware Hybrid Remake Routing (plan.py:LABEL_ROUTE)
• code_render (R01) & screen_capture (R02) -> code_render_spec (Remotion / HTML)
• still_motion (R17) & static_hold (R18) -> local_ffmpeg affine pan/zoom ($0 API)
• ai_video / cg_3d / avatar / live_action -> capsule_cinema shared-set batching
Reported eval/RESULTS.md (anonymized_reported, independently_reproduced=false):
Offline free tools: 98.9%–99.6% holdout | Re-encoded WeChat + VLM/Agent: 99.6%–100%
2. Closed-Form API-Only FinOps Model (25 Videos = 500 Shots/mo)
60% (300) deterministic UI/screen/pan shots + 40% (200) visual shots (100 shared sets)
Path A: Dense VLM (500 calls) + Blind All-Diffusion (500 shots × 3 = 1,500 calls)
Path B: Per-Shot VLM (500 calls) + Unbatched Diffusion (350 shots × 2 = 700 calls)
Path C: rea-video (150 grouped VLM calls + 300 Remotion/ffmpeg + 150 diffusion calls)
Synthetic API-only model (independently_reproduced=false); studio/talent/GPU infra: not_measured
3. Architect Selection Rules & 4-Tier Provenance Guardrails
✅ Choose JuneYaooo/rea-video (v0.1.0, Apache-2.0) when:
• Deconstructing mixed-media competitor promos / tutorials where UI cards, screen capture, live footage, and AI B-roll are interleaved.
• Routing code_render / screen_capture to Remotion / Playwright ($0 diffusion cost, 100% crisp text) and batching shared camera setups.
⛔ Do NOT use video diffusion on code_render / screen_capture shots, and watch out for:
• rapidocr-onnxruntime pulling GUI opencv-python over opencv-python-headless (use scripts/install_skill.sh to restore headless cv2).
• Provenance: Track B ~409★/day is 10-day creation-to-date mean (4,092★ / 10d, measured); stars_today is not_measured.
• Copyright guard: Shots classified as film_footage (R21-film-footage) require studio licensing or reshooting before commercial use.
